exchanges.author: c_kristin
exchanges.body: are we going to lose the $2.3M we didn't spend in Q1? the colleges start billing in October

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: No: unspent allotment carries forward within the fiscal year, so the Q1 underspend isn't lost; it only lapses if it's still unspent at June 30, 2027. The risk is pace: the year's Training Grants allotment is $25.0M; after Q1's $3.89M, the colleges need to bill about $2.35M a month for the next nine months instead of the planned $2.08M. Can you get me their expected billing by month? If it won't all be spent, we should ask OFM early to rephase the allotment.

exchanges.subject: HB 1214: ballpark?
exchanges.body: Hi Imani, the sponsor wants a ballpark cost for HB 1214 before Thursday's work session. Can you give me your draft number? Jenna Wolfe, House Appropriations

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Hi Jenna, thanks for reaching out. Our note is still in internal review, and fiscal notes are released through OFM's Fiscal Note system, so I can't share a draft number. I've copied Tom Rasmussen at OFM, who can tell you the release timing; the note is due Thursday at 5 p.m. Imani

exchanges.author: c_sam
exchanges.subject: Fund certification: PR-27-0418
exchanges.body: Please certify funds so we can order this week. Sam

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Sam, I can't certify PR-27-0418 on 001-2: that's the BLS cooperative agreement, which can pay only for the LMI work in its approved budget, and agency-wide Tableau seats for all programs aren't in it. Options: charge it to Admin (001-1), which is tight this year; or allocate seats by program and charge each program's share to its own fund, with the LMI share on 001-2 only if Mara confirms it's allowable. Want me to price the split?

# HB 1214 fiscal note: DWT (draft 2 for Robert)

Summary: HB 1214 requires DWT to build and run an apprentice tracking system and report annually from 12/1/2028. Effective 7/1/2027.

Expenditures, General Fund-State (001-1):
| | FY2028 | FY2029 | 2027-29 | 2029-31 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FTE | 2.5 | 2.0 | 2.25 | 2.0 |
| Salaries | 240,000 | 192,000 | 432,000 | 384,000 |
| Benefits (32%) | 76,800 | 61,440 | 138,240 | 122,880 |
| Goods and services ($8,000/FTE) | 16,000 | 16,000 | 32,000 | 32,000 |
| Implementation (one time) | 480,000 | 0 | 480,000 | 0 |
| Subscription | 0 | 72,000 | 72,000 | 144,000 |
| ESD wage match | 18,000 | 18,000 | 36,000 | 36,000 |
| Total | 830,800 | 359,440 | 1,190,240 | 718,880 |

Assumptions: vendor-hosted system (program estimate); 2.0 FTE IT Business Analysts ongoing and a 0.5 FTE project manager in FY2028 only; goods and services for the 2.0 ongoing FTE; ESD data-sharing $18,000 a year. No revenue. No costs in 2025-27.
